Final Report (Volumes 1-4) under contract DE-FG26-04NT42260 with the U.S. Department of Energy. Princeton Environmental Institute, Princeton University, Princeton, NJ, 21 December 2006. PDF holds all four volumes (Vol. 1 main report, Vol. 2 design/simulation detail, Vol. 3 fuel chain and national analysis, Vol. 4 low-temperature BLG); locators are printed page numbers within the named volume. Main file: 9 whole-system cases at the reference Southeastern US freesheet mill - new Tomlinson and mill-scale BLGCC (reprinted from the authors' 2003 study, costs escalated to 2005$) and the seven biorefineries DMEa/b/c, FTa/b/c, MA: black liquor input capacity, pulp output, capacity factor from 8,330 h, overnight installed capex (Table 22), non-fuel O&M 4%/yr, economic life, discount rate, construction time (Table 25), net electric and first-law efficiency (Table 13; BLGCC derived from Table 12), derived heat-to-power ratio, and liquid-fuel levelized cost (Table 24). _flows.csv: black liquor, biomass, lime kiln oil, natural gas inputs and steam/net electricity outputs per metric t bone-dry pulp, derived from Table 12 MW x 8,330 h / Table 29 pulp output. _other-values.csv: capital cost by plant area, gross power, eta_heat/eta_fuel/eta_el-equiv, liquid fuel outputs (DME, FT crude, mixed alcohols are not in the commodity vocabulary), Table 14 marginal efficiencies, Table 23 capital per annual barrel, mill characteristics (Table 5), emission assumptions (Tables 16-17), Vol. 4 LTBLG preliminary cost. Not loaded: Vol. 2 (flowsheet stream detail duplicating Vol. 1 summary results), Vol. 3 fuel-chain emission factors and national scenarios, price forecasts (Table 26), IRR/NPV results (Tables 31-32), market penetration (Tables 33-36); figures only read where they restate tables.

(1) Tomlinson and BLGCC results are reprinted from the 2003 study (escalated 2002$->2005$), and BLGCC carries a known minor O2-flow error the authors did not correct (Table 12 note c). (2) Tomlinson net electric efficiency is 13.3% in the text (p.16, BL + hog fuel only) vs 13.4% in Table 13 (all inputs incl. kiln oil); BLGCC is omitted from Table 13. (3) Table 22 area costs sum to the printed totals only within 1-2 thousand $ (rounding); wood-yard and one syngas-cooler cell blank for Tomlinson/BLGCC. (4) Non-fuel O&M is a flat 4% of capex, not an estimate, and is not split fixed/variable. (5) Capex covers only new equipment: pre-existing hog fuel boilers (81 MWth LHV) and, for Tomlinson and DMEa, the existing steam turbine are excluded, so totals are not full greenfield costs. (6) Lime kiln fuel oil is counted as a system input though the kiln is outside the capex scope. (7) Table 29 fuels are HHV while Table 12 is LHV; flows use Table 12 (LHV). (8) Table 23 and Figure 44 units give no price year explicitly (2005$ implied). (9) Table 12 note (b) ASU load exceeds the flowsheets by 0.58 MW; flowsheets and table do not match exactly. (10) Headings mix section numbers (3.2.2 vs 3.3.2; Sect. '0' cross-references).
